entries.title: Psalms 21:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> The king will be glad in your strength, O Lord; how great will be his delight in your salvation!

entries.title: Psalms 21:2
segments: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not kept back the request of his lips. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 21:3
segments: For you go before him with the blessings of good things: you put a crown of fair gold on his head.

entries.title: Psalms 21:4
segments: He made request to you for life, and you gave it to him, long life for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 21:5
segments: His glory is great in your salvation: honour and authority have you put on him.

entries.title: Psalms 21:6
segments: For you have made him a blessing for ever: you have given him joy in the light of your face.

entries.title: Psalms 21:7
segments: ¶For the king has faith in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Most High he will not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 21:8
segments: Your hand will make a search for all your haters; your right hand will be hard on all those who are against you.

entries.title: Psalms 21:9
segments: You will make them like a flaming oven before you; the Lord in his wrath will put an end to them, and they will be burned up in the fire.

entries.title: Psalms 21:10
segments: Their fruit will be cut off from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 21:11
segments: For their thoughts were bitter against you: they had an evil design in their minds, which they were not able to put into effect.

entries.title: Psalms 21:12
segments: Their backs will be turned when you make ready the cords of your bow against their faces.

entries.title: Psalms 21:13
segments: Be lifted up, O Lord, in your strength; so will we make songs in praise of your power.
